presence_rationale: Direct CET1 / leverage / capital adequacy disclosure in 'What we will be known for - Safe' section. NAB Pillar 3 Report describes risk approach, capital adequacy and liquidity. Full glossary of CET1, Tier 1, Tier 2 capital definitions per APS 111.
specificity_rationale: Names APS 111 Capital Adequacy Measurement of Capital, NAB Pillar 3 Report, on-market $2.5bn buy-back to manage CET1 toward 10.75-11.25% target range, new governance/risk/compliance system replacing multiple in-use risk systems. Sustainability Risk defined as material risk category. Strong APRA-aligned capital framework disclosure.
quantification_rationale: Reports SASB FN-CB-550a.1 directly (effectively): CET1 capital ratio 13.00% on APRA basis (17.95% internationally comparable basis). Leverage ratio 5.83%. CET1 target range 10.75-11.25%. $486M of $2.5bn buy-back completed since mid-Aug 2021. NAB is not a G-SIB but APRA Pillar 3 disclosure includes G-SIB indicators. SASB FN-CB-550a.1 (capital) substantively covered; FN-CB-550a.2 (stress test in capital planning) referenced via Pillar 3 pointer.
